transcript: We are loading the kiln for the second firing today. Sorry, that was the supplier on the phone. The glaze tiles from last week came out a deep even blue. [[img_001]] Next time I will try the darker oxide.

expect.note: A phone call cut in after the first sentence and held the mic for callSeconds; the picture was snapped while the third sentence was spoken. The recording clock stops for an interruption, so the manifest offset is the RECORDING-clock moment (offsetSeconds) and the picture lands after the third sentence. The wall clock would read offsetSeconds + callSeconds, past the last word, and drop the picture after the fourth.
